primary.text: run the Miami Beach Halloween Half Marathon
primary.metric: sub-2:05 (stretch goal sub-2:00), finish injury-free — PR is 1:52 but not chasing that this cycle; race is 11.7 weeks out as an accountability anchor for base-building

training_history.recent_volume: 12-16 mi/wk through June (Garmin), travel dip to ~5 mi first week of July

injuries.detail: achey, plantar-fascia pattern — worse with volume spikes
occasional shin splints when volume is not managed — ramp conservatively

preferences.protein_powder: pea or rice protein only (no whey, no soy)

context.equipment: bodyweight only through July; possible light gym access
context.pickleball: Capped at 1-2x/wk typical, up to 3x on a big week (self-imposed cap, set 2026-08-03 after pickleball repeatedly displaced runs in late July/early Aug). Fine to fold in on easy/rest days as bonus cross-training; should NOT displace the long run or a quality session once the week's cap is already hit — flag it if that starts happening rather than silently rescheduling.

targets.notes: Per-day targets computed from targets.model (session-type aware). macros_training_day/rest_day kept as representative fallback sets only.

pre.quality: 20-30 min before: banana or rice cake + honey, black coffee
pre.long: 25-30 min before: banana + rice cake w/ honey; bring water past 60 min
pre.easy: optional — half a banana if hungry; water + coffee is fine this early
pre.strength: 20-30 min before: banana or GF granola bar (check soy-free)

post.quality: within ~45 min: pea protein shake + banana or white rice
post.long: within 30-45 min: pea protein shake + fast carbs, then real breakfast
post.easy: breakfast within an hour: eggs + potatoes, or GF oats + berries
post.strength: within ~2 h: 35-40g protein — eggs + GF oats, or pea protein shake

model.notes: day kcal = tdee_baseline + session cost - deficit; protein constant; fat by day type; carbs = remainder. Key sessions carry the smallest deficit so they stay fueled.

optional_strength.title: Core + Lower Legs
optional_strength.note: Optional — after your run or anytime today (~12 min). 2 rounds normally, 3 if fresh; skip the day before the long run if legs feel heavy. Built around your arch + shin history.
